_help: Edit freely. 'windows' are [start, end] dates in Cambodia time (inclusive). 'yearly' repeats every year (MM-DD). Lunar festivals move each year, so add new windows when the government announces them. Effects: sellBonus (0.2 = +20% sell price), growth (0.8 = crops grow 20% faster), fishLuck (2 = rare fish twice as likely), giftRiel (daily gift). 'items' are decoration ids that can only be bought while the event is on.

name.km: បុណ្យចូលឆ្នាំខ្មែរ

desc.km: រីករាយឆ្នាំថ្មី! លក់បានថ្លៃជាងធម្មតា ហើយទទួលកាដូរាល់ថ្ងៃ។
desc.en: Happy New Year! Better sell prices and a daily gift.

name.km: ព្រះរាជពិធីច្រត់ព្រះនង្គ័ល

desc.km: ដំណាំដុះលឿនជាងមុន នៅពេលចាប់ផ្ដើមរដូវកសិកម្ម។
desc.en: Crops grow faster as the planting season opens.

name.km: ភ្ជុំបិណ្ឌ

desc.km: រំលឹកដល់បុព្វបុរស។ ទទួលកាដូរាល់ថ្ងៃ និងតម្លៃលក់ល្អជាងមុន។
desc.en: Remembering the ancestors. A daily gift and slightly better prices.

name.km: បុណ្យអុំទូក

desc.km: ត្រីកម្រចាប់បានងាយជាងមុន ហើយលក់បានថ្លៃជាង។
desc.en: Rare fish bite more often and everything sells for more.
